text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear opening claim: \"I do not support driverless cars\"","quality":"thesis clarity","description":"It states a direct position up front so the reader immediately knows the essay's stance."},{"evidence":"city versus far off from a city","quality":"reasoned development","description":"It develops the argument with a concrete access-and-availability point rather than only general opinions."},{"evidence":"\"take a long time to recieve a taxi\" / \"would not be able to at all\"","quality":"specific support","description":"It uses particular consequences to explain why driverless cars could be inconvenient in real life."},{"evidence":"\"It would also probably take a magnitude of money\"","quality":"practical concern","description":"It emphasizes cost as a concrete obstacle to adoption, strengthening the opposition with a realistic drawback."},{"evidence":"\"If it...were to malfunction, you would be stuck inside\"","quality":"risk analysis","description":"It presents a clear safety and reliability concern by showing what could happen if the technology fails."},{"evidence":"\"The psychological aspects of automation are really a challenge\"","quality":"integration of source material","description":"It weaves in a relevant quotation from the article to support the claim instead of relying only on unsupported assertions."}]}
